name: GitLab
description: The repositories your agents check out, branch and open merge requests. Connect to grant repository access so agents can clone, push and open merge requests.

tools.name: gitlab.read_repository
tools.description: Clone the repository and read its files.

tools.name: gitlab.create_branch
tools.description: Push a branch named for the task the agent is working.

tools.name: gitlab.open_merge_request
tools.description: Open a merge request for a person to review.

tools.name: gitlab.merge_merge_request
tools.description: Merge without waiting for a human review.
